records.title: ABSS for Maroda Railway Station
details: a to d: The work for construction of Road Under Bridge (RUB) in lieu of level Crossing (LC) Nos. DD-19 (Risama Level Crossing) at Km 889/7-8 has been sanctioned. The work of launching of segment boxes has been taken up.
